articles.title_en: When Less is More: Improving Choices in Health Insurance Markets
articles.title_cn: 少即是多：改善健康保险市场中的选择
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of changing choice set size on the quality of choices in health insurance markets. Using novel data on enrolment and medical claims for school district employees in the state of Oregon, we document that the average employee could save $600 by switching to a lower cost plan. Structural modelling reveals large “choice inconsistencies” such as non-equalization of the dollar spent on premiums and out of pocket, and a novel form of “approximate inertia” where enrolees are excessively likely to switch to other plans that are close to the current plan on the plan design spreadsheet. Variation in the number of plan choices across districts and over time shows that enrolees make lower-cost choices when the choice set is smaller. We show that a curated restriction of choice set size improves choices more than the best available information intervention, partly because approximate inertia lowers gains from new information. We explicitly test and reject the assumption that this is because individuals choose worse from larger choice sets, or “choice overload”. Rather, we show that this feature arises from the fact that larger choice sets feature worse choices on average that are not offset by individual re-optimization.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了改变选择集大小对健康保险市场中选择质量的影响。利用俄勒冈州学区员工参保和医疗索赔的新数据，我们记录了普通员工通过转向较低成本计划可节省600美元。结构建模揭示了巨大的“选择不一致性”，例如保费支出和自付费用之间的美元不等值，以及一种新颖的“近似惯性”形式，即参保者过度倾向于转向计划设计电子表格中与当前计划接近的其他计划。不同地区和不同时间计划选择数量的变化表明，当选择集较小时，参保者会做出成本较低的选择。我们表明，对选择集大小的精心限制比最佳可用信息干预更能改善选择，部分原因是近似惯性降低了新信息的收益。我们明确检验并拒绝了这一假设，即这是因为个体从较大的选择集中选择更差，或“选择过载”。相反，我们表明这一特征源于较大选择集平均包含更差的选择，而这些选择并未被个体的重新优化所抵消。

articles.title_en: Wall Street and Silicon Valley: A Delicate Interaction
articles.title_cn: 华尔街与硅谷：微妙的互动
articles.abstract_en: Entrepreneurs and venture capitalists are concerned about investors’ beliefs in asset markets because these beliefs shape the value of a potential IPO and the possibility to expand. Investors’ beliefs, on the other hand, can be influenced by start-up activity insofar as the latter contains valuable information about eventual profitability. This two-way feedback is shown to generate excessive, non-fundamental, waves in start-up activity, IPOs, and asset prices. Policies that “lean against the wind” can improve welfare, without requiring an informational advantage by the government.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业家和风险投资家关注投资者在资产市场中的信念，因为这些信念决定了潜在IPO的价值以及扩张的可能性。另一方面，投资者的信念可能受到初创活动的影响，因为初创活动包含有关最终盈利能力的宝贵信息。这种双向反馈被证明会在初创活动、IPO和资产价格中产生过度的、非基本的波动。‘逆风而行’的政策可以提高福利，而不需要政府拥有信息优势。

articles.title_cn: 动态失衡市场中的匹配
articles.abstract_en: We study dynamic matching in exchange markets with easy- and hard-to-match agents. A greedy policy, which attempts to match agents upon arrival, ignores the positive externality that waiting agents provide by facilitating future matchings. We prove that the trade-off between a “thicker” market and faster matching vanishes in large markets; the greedy policy leads to shorter waiting times and more agents matched than any other policy. We empirically confirm these findings in data from the National Kidney Registry. Greedy matching achieves as many transplants as commonly used policies (1.8$\%$ more than monthly batching) and shorter waiting times (16 days faster than monthly batching).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有易匹配和难匹配代理人的交换市场中的动态匹配。一种贪婪策略，即在代理人到达时尝试匹配，忽略了等待代理人通过促进未来匹配所提供的正外部性。我们证明了在大型市场中，“更厚”市场与更快匹配之间的权衡消失；贪婪策略导致更短的等待时间和比任何其他策略更多的代理人匹配。我们在国家肾脏登记处的数据中实证确认了这些发现。贪婪匹配实现了与常用策略一样多的移植（比月度批处理多1.8%），并且等待时间更短（比月度批处理快16天）。

articles.title_en: Infrequent Random Portfolio Decisions in an Open Economy Model
articles.title_cn: 开放经济模型中的低频随机投资组合决策
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a portfolio friction in a two-country DSGE model where investors face a constant probability to make new portfolio decisions. The friction leads to a more gradual portfolio adjustment to shocks and a weaker portfolio response to changes in expected excess returns. We apply the model to monthly data for the US and the rest of the world for equity portfolios. We show that the model is consistent with a broad set of evidence related to portfolios, equity prices, and excess returns for an intermediate level of friction. The evidence includes portfolio inertia, limited sensitivity to expected excess returns, a significant impact of financial shocks, excess return predictability, and asset price momentum and reversal.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个两国DSGE模型中引入投资组合摩擦，其中投资者面临恒定的概率来做出新的投资组合决策。这种摩擦导致投资组合对冲击的调整更加渐进，以及对预期超额收益变化的投资组合反应减弱。我们将该模型应用于美国和世界其他地区的股票投资组合的月度数据。我们表明，对于中等程度的摩擦，该模型与一系列与投资组合、股票价格和超额收益相关的广泛证据一致。这些证据包括投资组合惯性、对预期超额收益的有限敏感性、金融冲击的显著影响、超额收益可预测性以及资产价格动量和反转。

articles.title_en: Multinomial Logit Processes and Preference Discovery: Inside and Outside the Black Box
articles.title_cn: 多项Logit过程与偏好发现：黑箱内外
articles.abstract_en: We provide two characterizations, one axiomatic and the other neuro-computational, of the dependence of choice probabilities on deadlines, within the widely used softmax representation $$\begin{align*} p_{t}\left( a,A\right) =\dfrac{e^{\frac{u\left( a\right) }{\lambda\left( t\right) }+\alpha\left( a\right) }}{\sum_{b\in A}e^{\frac{u\left( b\right) }{\lambda\left( t\right) }+\alpha\left( b\right) }}, \end{align*}$$ where $p_{t}\left( a,A\right)$ is the probability that alternative $a$ is selected from the set $A$ of feasible alternatives if $t$ is the time available to decide, $\lambda$ is a time-dependent noise parameter measuring the unit cost of information, $u$ is a time-independent utility function, and $\alpha$ is an alternative-specific bias that determines the initial choice probabilities (reflecting prior information and memory anchoring). Our axiomatic analysis provides a behavioural foundation of softmax (also known as Multinomial Logit Model when $\alpha$ is constant). Our neuro-computational derivation provides a biologically inspired algorithm that may explain the emergence of softmax in choice behaviour. Jointly, the two approaches provide a thorough understanding of softmaximization in terms of internal causes (neuro-physiological mechanisms) and external effects (testable implications).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了两种刻画，一种是公理性的，另一种是神经计算性的，关于选择概率对截止时间的依赖性，在广泛使用的softmax表示中：p_t(a,A)=e^{u(a)/λ(t)+α(a)}/∑_{b∈A}e^{u(b)/λ(t)+α(b)}，其中p_t(a,A)是在给定决策时间t时从可行备选集合A中选择备选a的概率，λ是依赖于时间的噪声参数，衡量信息的单位成本，u是独立于时间的效用函数，α是决定初始选择概率的备选特定偏差（反映先验信息和记忆锚定）。我们的公理分析为softmax（当α为常数时也称为多项Logit模型）提供了行为基础。我们的神经计算推导提供了一种受生物学启发的算法，可能解释softmax在选择行为中的出现。两种方法共同提供了对softmax最大化在内部原因（神经生理机制）和外部效应（可检验的含义）方面的全面理解。

articles.title_en: Estimating Intergenerational and Assortative Processes in Extended Family Data
articles.title_cn: 估算扩展家庭数据中的代际与 assortative 过程
articles.abstract_en: We quantify intergenerational and assortative processes by comparing different degrees of kinship within the same generation. This “horizontal” approach yields more, and more distant kinship moments than traditional methods, which allows us to account for the transmission of latent advantages in a detailed intergenerational model. Using Swedish registers, we find strong persistence in the latent determinants of status, and a striking degree of sorting—to explain the similarity of distant kins, assortative matching must be much stronger than previously thought. Latent genetic influences explain little of the variance in educational attainment, and sorting occurs primarily in non-genetic factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过比较同一代内不同亲属关系程度来量化代际和 assortative 过程。这种“横向”方法比传统方法产生更多、更远的亲属矩，这使我们能够在详细的代际模型中考虑潜在优势的传递。利用瑞典登记数据，我们发现地位潜在决定因素中存在强烈的持续性，以及显著的排序程度——要解释远亲的相似性，assortative 匹配必须比先前认为的强得多。潜在遗传影响对教育成就的方差解释很少，排序主要发生在非遗传因素中。

articles.title_en: Price Discrimination and Public Policy in the US College Market
articles.title_cn: 美国大学市场中的价格歧视与公共政策
articles.abstract_en: In the US, the federal government grants colleges access to a student’s Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) which facilitates substantial price discrimination. This article is the first to estimate the consequences of allowing colleges to use the FAFSA in their pricing decisions. I build and estimate a structural model of college pricing and simulate counterfactuals wherein some or all of the FAFSA information is restricted. I find that if FAFSA information were restricted, 13$\%$ of students attending elite colleges would be inefficiently priced out of the elite market. Nevertheless, student welfare would rise as colleges charged the majority of students lower prices. Colleges do use the FAFSA to transfer resources from high- to low-income students on average, but this redistribution is highly imprecise: allowing colleges to use the FAFSA harms one-third of low-income students while one in seven high-income students actually benefit.
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国，联邦政府允许大学获取学生的免费申请联邦学生援助（FAFSA）信息，这促进了大量的价格歧视。本文首次估计了允许大学在定价决策中使用FAFSA的后果。我构建并估计了一个大学定价的结构模型，并模拟了部分或全部FAFSA信息受到限制的反事实情况。我发现，如果FAFSA信息受到限制，13%的精英大学学生将因效率低下而被挤出精英市场。然而，学生福利将会上升，因为大学对大多数学生收取较低的价格。平均而言，大学确实利用FAFSA将资源从高收入学生转移到低收入学生，但这种再分配非常不精确：允许大学使用FAFSA损害了三分之一低收入学生的利益，而七分之一的高收入学生实际上受益。

articles.title_en: Marginal Jobs and Job Surplus: A Test of the Efficiency of Separations
articles.title_cn: 边际岗位与岗位剩余：对离职效率的检验
articles.abstract_en: We present a test of Coasean theories of efficient separations. We study a cohort of jobs from the introduction through the repeal of a large age- and region-specific unemployment benefit extension in Austria. In the treatment group, 18.5% fewer jobs survive the program period. According to the Coasean view, the destroyed marginal jobs had low joint surplus. Hence, after the repeal, the treatment survivors should be more resilient than the ineligible control group survivors. Strikingly, the two groups instead exhibit identical post-repeal separation behaviour. We provide, and find suggestive evidence consistent with, an alternative model in which wage rigidity drives the inefficient separation dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们检验科斯关于有效率离职的理论。我们研究奥地利一批岗位在一项按年龄和地区划分的大规模失业福利延长政策从引入到废止期间的变化。处理组在该计划期间存续的岗位少18.5%。按照科斯观点，被摧毁的边际岗位联合剩余较低。因此，政策废止后，处理组中存续岗位应比不符合资格的对照组存续岗位更具韧性。然而，令人惊讑的是，两组在废止后的离职行为完全相同。我们提出一种替代模型，并发现提示性证据与之相符：工资刚性推动了低效率的离职动态。

articles.title_en: Asset Prices and Unemployment Fluctuations: A Resolution of the Unemployment Volatility Puzzle
articles.title_cn: 资产价格与失业波动：失业波动之谜的解决
articles.abstract_en: Recent work has demonstrated that existing solutions of the unemployment volatility puzzle are at odds with the procylicality of the opportunity cost of employment, the cyclicality of wages, and the volatility of risk-free rates. We propose a model of business cycles that is immune to these critiques by incorporating two key features. First, we allow for preferences that generate time-varying risk over the business cycle to account for observed fluctuations in asset prices. Second, we introduce human capital acquisition, as is consistent with the evidence on how wages grow with experience in the labor market. Our model reproduces the observed fluctuations in unemployment because hiring a worker is a risky investment with long-duration returns. As in the data, the price of risk in our model sharply increases in recessions. The benefit from hiring new workers therefore greatly declines, leading to a large decrease in job vacancies and an increase in unemployment of the same magnitude as in the data. We show that our results extend to versions of the model that include physical capital, a life cycle for workers, and alternative preference structures common in the asset-pricing literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期研究表明，现有对失业波动之谜的解决方案与就业机会成本的顺周期性、工资的周期性以及无风险利率的波动性相矛盾。我们提出了一个商业周期模型，通过纳入两个关键特征来避免这些批评。首先，我们允许产生随时间变化的风险偏好的偏好结构，以解释观察到的资产价格波动。其次，我们引入人力资本积累，这与工资随劳动力市场经验增长的证据一致。我们的模型再现了观察到的失业波动，因为雇佣工人是一项具有长期回报的风险投资。与数据一致，我们模型中的风险价格在经济衰退时急剧上升。因此，雇佣新工人的收益大幅下降，导致职位空缺大幅减少，失业增加幅度与数据相同。我们表明，我们的结果扩展到包含物质资本、工人生命周期以及资产定价文献中常见的替代偏好结构的模型版本。

articles.abstract_en: We estimate the dynamic causal effects of consumer sentiment shocks in the US. We identify autonomous changes in survey evidence on consumer confidence using fatalities in mass shootings as an instrument. We find the instrument to be significant for an aggregate index of consumer expectations and also back up the identification scheme with micro evidence that exploits the geographical variation in mass shootings. Sentiment shocks have real macroeconomic effects. A negative sentiment shock is recessionary: It sets off a persistent decline in consumer confidence and induces a contraction in industrial production, private sector consumption and in the labour market, while having less evident nominal effects. Finally, sentiment shocks explain a non-negligible part of the cyclical fluctuations in consumer confidence and real macroeconomic aggregates.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了美国消费者情绪冲击的动态因果效应。我们利用大规模枪击事件中的死亡人数作为工具变量，识别消费者信心调查证据中的自主变化。我们发现该工具变量对消费者预期的总体指数具有显著性，并且通过利用大规模枪击事件地理差异的微观证据支持了识别方案。情绪冲击具有真实的宏观经济效应。负向情绪冲击会导致衰退：它引发消费者信心的持续下降，并导致工业生产、私营部门消费和劳动力市场的收缩，而对名义变量的影响则不那么明显。最后，情绪冲击解释了消费者信心和实际宏观经济总量周期波动中不可忽视的一部分。

articles.title_en: Consumer Search and Prices in the Automobile Market
articles.title_cn: 汽车市场中的消费者搜索与价格
articles.abstract_en: This article develops a discrete choice model of demand with optimal sequential consumer search. Consumers first choose a product to search; then, once they learn the utility they get from the searched product, they choose whether to buy it or to keep searching. We characterize the search problem as a standard discrete choice problem and propose a parametric search cost distribution that generates closed-form expressions for the probability of purchasing a product. We propose a method to estimate the model that supplements aggregate product data with individual-specific data which allows for the separate identification of search costs and preferences. We estimate the model using data from the automobile industry and find that search costs have non-trivial implications for elasticities and markups. We study the effects of exclusive dealing regulation and find that firms benefit at the expense of consumers, who face higher search costs and higher prices than would be the case if multi-brand dealerships were used.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个具有最优序贯消费者搜索的需求离散选择模型。消费者首先选择一个产品进行搜索；然后，一旦他们了解到所搜索产品带来的效用，他们便决定是购买该产品还是继续搜索。我们将搜索问题刻画为一个标准的离散选择问题，并提出一个参数化的搜索成本分布，该分布为购买产品的概率提供了闭式表达式。我们提出了一种估计该模型的方法，该方法将总体产品数据与个体特定数据相结合，从而能够分别识别搜索成本和偏好。我们利用汽车行业的数据估计该模型，发现搜索成本对弹性和加成具有非平凡的影响。我们研究了排他性经销监管的效果，发现企业受益，而消费者则面临更高的搜索成本和更高的价格，相比之下，如果采用多品牌经销店，情况则有所不同。

articles.title_cn: 观察学习下的声誉建立
articles.abstract_en: A patient seller interacts with a sequence of myopic consumers. Each period, the seller chooses the quality of his product, and a consumer decides whether to trust the seller after she observes the seller’s actions in the last $K$ periods (limited memory) and at least one previous consumer’s action (observational learning). However, the consumer cannot observe the seller’s action in the current period. With positive probability, the seller is a commitment type who plays his Stackelberg action in every period. I show that under limited memory and observational learning, consumers are concerned that the seller will not play his Stackelberg action when he has a positive reputation and will play his Stackelberg action after he has lost his reputation. Such a concern leads to equilibria where the seller receives a low payoff from building a reputation. I also show that my reputation failure result hinges on consumers’ observational learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 一位耐心的卖家与一系列短视的消费者互动。在每个时期，卖家选择其产品质量，而消费者在观察到卖家过去$K$期的行为（有限记忆）以及至少一位先前消费者的行为（观察学习）后，决定是否信任卖家。然而，消费者无法观察到卖家当前时期的行为。以正概率存在一种承诺型卖家，他在每个时期都采取其斯塔克尔伯格行动。我证明，在有限记忆和观察学习下，消费者担心当卖家拥有正声誉时不会采取其斯塔克尔伯格行动，而在失去声誉后会采取其斯塔克尔伯格行动。这种担忧导致了卖家从建立声誉中获得低收益的均衡。我还证明，我的声誉失败结果取决于消费者的观察学习。

articles.title_en: We Are All Behavioural, More, or Less: A Taxonomy of Consumer Decision-Making
articles.title_cn: 我们都是行为性的，或多或少：消费者决策分类学
articles.abstract_en: We examine how 17 behavioural biases relate to each other, to three standard measures of risk and time preferences, to cognitive skills, personality, and demographics, and to outcomes in household finance, well-being, and health. Most consumers in our nationally representative panel data exhibit multiple biases, with substantial cross-person heterogeneity. Biases are positively correlated within person, especially after adjusting for measurement error. From that correlation structure, we reduce our 20 bias and standard preference measures to four behavioural common factors. Each BCF reflects a group of related biases regarding beliefs, decision quality, discounting, or risk/uncertainty attitudes. The first two BCFs also strongly correlate with each other (positively) and cognitive skills (negatively). The first three BCFs and cognitive skills strongly correlate with various outcomes in the expected directions. Our results support processing-based models where basic limitations in cognition and/or attention produce multiple biases, and they have several other implications for theory and practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了17种行为偏差如何相互关联，如何与风险和时间偏好的三个标准度量、认知技能、个性、人口统计学特征以及家庭金融、幸福感和健康结果相关联。我们具有全国代表性的面板数据中的大多数消费者表现出多种偏差，且个体间存在显著异质性。偏差在个体内部呈正相关，尤其是在调整测量误差后。从该相关结构中，我们将20种偏差和标准偏好度量减少为四个行为共同因子。每个BCF反映了一组关于信念、决策质量、贴现或风险/不确定性态度的相关偏差。前两个BCF也彼此（正）相关，并与认知技能（负）相关。前三个BCF和认知技能与各种结果在预期方向上强相关。我们的结果支持基于处理的模型，其中认知和/或注意力的基本限制产生多种偏差，并且对理论和实践还有其他几个启示。

articles.abstract_en: By exploiting new macroeconomic data known as foreign affiliates statistics, we show that affiliates of foreign multinational firms are an order of magnitude more profitable than local firms in a number of low-tax countries. Leveraging this differential profitability, we estimate that 36% of multinational profits are shifted to tax havens globally. US multinationals shift twice as much profit as other multinationals relative to the size of their foreign earnings. We analyse how the location of corporate profits would change if shifted profits were reallocated to their source countries. Domestic profits would increase by about 20% in high-tax European Union countries, 10% in the US, and 5% in developing countries, while they would fall by 55% in tax havens. We provide a new international database of GDP, trade balances, and factor shares corrected for profit shifting. In contrast to the picture painted by official statistics, our results suggest that the corporate capital share has increased not only in North America but also in high-tax European countries. Capital is making a comeback globally, but its rise is obscured by the tax avoidance strategies of multinational companies.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用一种称为外国附属机构统计的新宏观经济数据，我们表明，在一些低税国家，外国跨国企业附属机构的利润率比本地企业高一个数量级。借助这一利润率差异，我们估计全球跨国企业利润的36%被转移到避税天堂。相对于外国收益规模，美国跨国企业转移的利润是其他跨国企业的两倍。我们分析，如果将转移利润重新分配回来源国，公司利润所在地会如何变化：高税率欧盟国家的国内利润将增加约20%，美国增加10%，发展中国家增加5%，而避税天堂将减少55%。我们建立了一个新的国际数据库，包含经利润转移修正后的GDP、贸易收支和要素份额。与官方统计所描绘的图景不同，我们的结果表明，企业资本份额不仅在北美上升，也在高税率欧洲国家上升。资本正在全球范围内重新崛起，但其上升被跨国企业的避税策略所掩盖。

articles.title_en: Hours Constraints, Occupational Choice, and Gender: Evidence from Medical Residents
articles.title_cn: 工时约束、职业选择与性别：来自住院医师的证据
articles.abstract_en: Do the long work hours required by many high-paying professions inhibit the entry of women? I investigate this question by studying a 2003 policy that capped the average workweek for medical residents at 80 hours. Using data on the universe of US medical school graduates, I find that when a specialty reduces its weekly hours, more women enter the specialty, whereas there is little change in men’s entry. I provide evidence that the increase in women is due to changes in labour supply, rather than labour demand. At the residency program level, I document that baseline female representation predicts female entry after the reform. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the reallocation of women among medical specialties due to the hours reduction can close the physician gender wage gap by 11$\%$.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多高薪职业所需的长时间工作是否阻碍了女性的进入？我通过研究一项2003年的政策来探讨这个问题，该政策将住院医师的平均每周工作时间上限设定为80小时。利用美国医学院毕业生的总体数据，我发现当一个专业减少每周工作时间时，更多女性进入该专业，而男性的进入几乎没有变化。我提供的证据表明，女性的增加是由于劳动力供给的变化，而非劳动力需求。在住院医师项目层面，我记录了基线女性代表性可预测改革后女性的进入。一项粗略计算表明，由于工时减少导致的女性在医学专业间的重新分配，可以缩小医生性别工资差距11%。
